offline.body: Check your internet connection and try again.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.body: BondCheck could not reach its server. Please try again in a few minutes.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This section is not available yet. It will appear here automatically.

unauthorized.title: Wallet not recognised
unauthorized.body: This phone's wallet key is no longer valid. Restore it with your sync code.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.body: Please wait a little and try again.

invalid.title: Please check your input
invalid.body: Something you entered was not accepted. Check it and try again.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: We could not find what you were looking for.

notConfigured.title: App not configured
notConfigured.body: This build has no website address. Install the app from the official download page.

home.walletPromoTitle: Save your bonds, no account needed
home.walletPromoBody: We check every new draw for you and remind you on draw day.
home.noUpcoming: No upcoming draws are listed yet.

check.title: Check your prize bonds
check.numbersHelp: Six digits each. Separate with spaces, commas or new lines. Write a series as 123400-123450.
check.invalidTokens: These are not six digit numbers: {tokens}
check.tooMany: Check at most {max} numbers at a time.
check.scanFound_one: Found {count} number. Review it above before checking.
check.scanFound_other: Found {count} numbers. Review them above before checking.
check.scanNone: No six digit numbers were found. Try again in better light or type them in.
check.scanUnsupported: Scanning is not available on this phone. Please type the numbers.
check.scanFailed: The photo could not be read. Please try again or type the numbers.
check.cameraDenied: Camera access was not allowed. You can type the numbers instead.
check.empty: Enter at least one six digit number.
check.coverageNote: Checked against every draw we hold. Always confirm a win with the official list before claiming.
check.saveToWallet: Save these numbers to My bonds
check.pickDenominationToSave: Choose a denomination above to save these numbers to My bonds.

draws.title: Draws
draws.intro: Official results for every denomination, checked against more than one source where possible.
draws.emptyBody: Results for this denomination have not been published here yet.
draws.sourceNote: Withdrawn bearer bonds can still be encashed until their deadline. Check the official National Savings notice.

draw.title: Draw
draw.amountsInPkr: Amounts in Pakistani rupees, before tax.
draw.findTitle: Find a number in this draw
draw.lookupNone: This number did not win in this draw.

wallet.onboardingBody: Save your prize bonds once. BondCheck checks them against every past draw and every new one.
wallet.pointNoAccount: No sign up, no phone number, no email.
wallet.pointAlerts: Reminders on draw day and an alert when you win.
wallet.pointSync: Move to a new phone with a 12 character sync code.
wallet.privacyNote: Only your bond numbers are stored, linked to a random wallet key kept safely on this phone.
wallet.claimReminder: Claim prizes at a National Savings centre or authorised bank branch before the deadline.
wallet.emptyBody: Add your bonds by typing them, pasting a list or scanning them with the camera.
wallet.removeBody: Bond {number} will no longer be checked.
wallet.noWinsBody: Every new draw is checked automatically. Good luck!
wallet.lostAccessTitle: This wallet needs to be restored
wallet.lostAccessBody: The wallet key on this phone is no longer accepted. Restore your wallet with its sync code.
wallet.forget: Remove the wallet from this phone

walletAdd.title: Add bonds
walletAdd.intro: Choose the denomination, then type, paste or scan your bond numbers.

walletRestore.title: Restore wallet
walletRestore.intro: Enter the sync code shown when the wallet was created, or in Settings on your other phone.
walletRestore.codeHelp: 12 letters and digits, for example ABCD-2345-WXYZ
walletRestore.invalid: A sync code has 12 letters and digits.
walletRestore.notFound: That sync code was not recognised. Check it and try again.
walletRestore.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait an hour and try again.
walletRestore.note: After restoring, a new sync code is issued and the old one stops working.

walletCreated.title: Sync code
walletCreated.heading: Your wallet is ready
walletCreated.body: This is your sync code. It is the only way to open your wallet on another phone. Save it somewhere safe.
walletCreated.warning: Anyone with this code can see your saved bond numbers. Keep it private.

rates.rowA11y: {name}: {tola} rupees per tola, {tenG} rupees per 10 grams, {kind}
rates.estimatedNote: Estimated rates are calculated from the world price and the rupee rate; jewellers' prices may differ.
rates.fxA11y: {currency}: open market buy and sell {open}, interbank {inter}
rates.fxNote: Rupees per one unit of each currency.
rates.emptyBody: Rates will appear here once they are collected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageNote: The app restarts to switch between left to right and right to left layout.
settings.drawRemindersHelp: At 9 am on the day of each draw for the denominations you own.
settings.winAlertsHelp: BondCheck checks for new results in the background and tells you when you win.
settings.needsWallet: Create or restore a wallet to turn on notifications.
settings.notificationsDenied: Notifications are turned off for BondCheck in your phone settings.
settings.syncCodeHelp: Use this code to open your wallet on another phone.
settings.rotateBody: The current code will stop working. Your bonds are not affected.
settings.deleteBody: Your saved bonds and wins are erased from BondCheck. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacySummary: No account, no tracking, no location.

update.title: Update
update.availableBody: A new version of BondCheck is ready to install.
update.requiredBody: This version is no longer supported. Install the update to keep checking your bonds.
update.howTo: The file downloads in your browser. Open it and allow installation from this source if Android asks.
update.untrusted: The download link did not come from the BondCheck website, so it was blocked.

notifications.drawTodayBody: Results are usually out by the evening. {date}
notifications.drawTodayBodyCity: Draw in {city}. Results are usually out by the evening. {date}
